title: Scalar balancing commutes with inverse-image section cancellation
statement: Let A,B be commutative rings and φ:A→B unital. Let p:T→S and i:S→T be morphisms of schemes with i≫p=1. For every ordinary etale derived A-module C on S, the inverse scalar/pullback comparison at i, followed by i*_B of the inverse comparison at p and the B section cancellation, equals scalar extension of the A section cancellation. In notation λ for scalarPullbackIso [def-pur-etale-scalar-pullback-iso] and c for the canonical inverse-image section compositor, λ_i^{-1}(p_A^*C)≫i_B^*(λ_p^{-1}(C))≫c_B(C_B)=S_φ(c_A(C)).

source.place: Proof (2), finite coefficient extension of the vector-bundle and deformation constructions, with normalization at t=1.

proof.text: Identify the inverse scalar comparison with the scalar-adjunction mate. The ordinary restriction square respects inverse-image composition and the identity, so it respects cancellation along i followed by p. Transpose both desired maps under the scalar adjunction. Its unit equations replace each inverse scalar comparison by the restriction square. Naturality moves the intermediate comparison across that square, and the restriction cancellation identity reduces the composite to naturality of the section compositor. Injectivity of the adjunction bijection gives the result. No flatness or finiteness is used.

proof_origin.place: Detailed specialization of the cited blueprint argument, with explicit canonical ordinary maps.

theorem scalar_section_compositor
    {A B : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] (φ : A →+* B)
    {T S : Scheme.{u}} (i : S ⟶ T) (p : T ⟶ S) (hi : i ≫ p = 𝟙 S)
    (C : DerivedCategoryModule A S) :
    (scalarPullbackIso φ i).inv.app
        ((upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) p).leftDerivedFunctor.obj C) ≫
      (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B) i).leftDerivedFunctor.map
        ((scalarPullbackIso φ p).inv.app C) ≫
      (leftDerivedUpperStarCompSectionIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B) i p hi).hom.app
        ((scalarExtension φ S).obj C) =
    (scalarExtension φ S).map
      ((leftDerivedUpperStarCompSectionIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) i p hi).hom.app C)
